ledger: Person (olive pourer, face never in frame) | navy blue button-up overshirt over white t-shirt, rolled sleeves, khaki pants; standing behind wooden counter facing camera/jar | same wardrobe and position at end; silver chain bracelet visible on left wrist in later frames | left wrist appears bare in 00:00-00:04 frames, bracelet present from ~00:04.5 onward; body stays behind jar throughout, actions continuous across camera angle shifts at ~00:04.5 and ~00:06

findings.description: A silver chain bracelet is clearly visible on the person's left wrist from ~00:04.5 onward (reaching to the bowl, then holding the container). In the earlier pouring sequence (00:00.0-00:04.0) the same left wrist and forearm are bare with rolled sleeves and no bracelet is visible. No on-screen action shows the bracelet being put on, and the pouring task is continuous, so its sudden appearance is unexplained.
